text:
oliver: hey team 👋 first day here — finished imaging but hitting a few provisioning snags: Okta login worked but Security shows "No factors configured for user", Google Drive link from my manager returns 403, 1Password invite email errors with "seat already claimed", and trying to add Windows Hello passkey fails with "Credential registration rejected". who should I poke?
it-support: welcome oliver! can you confirm you used your corporate email and not an alias? which Windows build? any company MDM prompts?
oliver: signed in with oliver.k@redwood.com, Windows 11 Pro, company image. jamf shows device pending. Okta lists my user but no factors. 1Password invite appears addressed to my corp email but the UI shows "claimed by oliver.k+personal@gmail.com". Windows Hello popup just says "Credential registration rejected" and gives no extra code.
onboarding-bot: Hi and welcome! Typical onboarding flow: Okta -> SCIM -> apps/Drive/1Password/MDM. If provisioning stalls >15m tag @it-support and @idp. Docs: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/welcome :book:
idp: tagging in. quick scan: SCIM job for oliver at 06:42 UTC hit a 429 (rate limit) and aborted before groups were attached. also a legacy Google migration imported a +alias which explains the 1Password seat collision. i'll remove alias and re-run groupsync.
it-support: Jamf showing pending encryption profile can block some factor enrollments until the device finishes. emma — can you re-share the Drive or add the user manually while idp fixes groups?
emma-manager: just re-shared the project folder and gave oliver direct access. should be available after refresh.
oliver: refreshed — Drive still 403 then suddenly opened after another reload, so that looks good. 1Password still errors though.
idp: removed the +personal alias and reissued a fresh 1Password invite to oliver.k@redwood.com (new token). also bumped SCIM retry/backoff and re-ran the groupsync; jobs completed at 06:55 UTC.
it-support: for the Windows Hello failure try: 1) open Windows Security -> Device security -> ensure TPM is enabled; 2) Settings -> Accounts -> Sign-in options -> remove any leftover keys under Security Keys; 3) reboot and retry in Edge (Chromium) or via the Okta factor setup page. if TPM attestation is blocked by the image, we'll swap the device.
oliver: TPM is enabled. removed leftover keys and retried in Edge — Windows Hello registration succeeded! 1Password link worked after the new invite too :tada:
sec-team-bot: FYI we temporarily relaxed the WebAuthn USB policy for new hires while idp resolves alias imports. created audit ticket TKT-7182.
idp: confirmed group assignments applied; Okta now shows Okta Verify and Security Key factors. Drive and 1Password fixed. root cause: SCIM rate limit plus stale alias from Google migration. follow-ups: add exponential backoff to SCIM runner, add an alias filter to the migration script, and monitor for similar 429s.
it-support: final checklist for oliver: 1) Jamf encryption pending — should finish automatically in ~10m; 2) Windows Hello passkey registered; 3) 1Password seat claimed and onboarding vault present; 4) Drive access confirmed. please DM if Jamf doesn't complete.
oliver: all working now, thanks everyone — excited to get started! :rocket:
